## Rules

- Six profiles and exact semantics are §6. Parse constraints; never hardcode a false all-packages cross-product. Every supported package gets min/max and prefer-lowest coverage. New temp consumer/cache/home per run; dist only; missing/unsupported is explicit red/excluded.

## Guidance

Reuse candidate/export and current pristine proof helpers. Capture `composer show --locked`, discovery output, installed paths and probe results. For removal profiles require/remove, rebuild optimized autoload and boot again.
